Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. Getting that right is one of the most critical and complex challenges at Legora. Every jurisdiction holds billions of pages of critical legal text scattered across hundreds of sources: statutes, case law, regulatory guidance, secondary materials, and more. Only about 3% is publicly accessible on the web. The rest is buried across courts, agencies, and archives. Getting this right doesn't just improve a product feature. It shapes how lawyers around the world navigate legal information for the next several decades. As a Legal Data Analyst at Legora, you will own this challenge. You will be responsible for mapping the legal source ecosystem, deciding and prioritising what we go after, and determining how this content is structured and systematised. You will be the one who makes sure we actually get legal data right. Few roles at the company have more direct impact on Legora AI's ability to navigate the law correctly. THE ROLE We're hiring a Head of Corporate Legal to build and lead Legora's corporate, securities, governance and M&A function as we prepare to operate as a public company. You will build the team and do the work on the Legora aOS, shaping the product along the way. At Legora’s pace of growth, new entities, acquisitions, financings and Board work land in the same quarter, and public-company discipline has to arrive early, without slowing the company down. The right candidate will have taken a company public from the inside and then run the corporate function through the quarters that followed. You know where that work most needs a lawyer's judgment, and you are excited about how much technology can now help with the rest. Reporting to the General Counsel, you will work closely with the entire C-Suite and Board of Directors, as well as the Finance team, Corporate Development, Product and People teams. WHAT YOU’LL DO 1. Build the Corporate Legal Team of the Future on Legora Legora Legal is customer zero. You will run our corporate function on the Legora aOS, and help shape it into the platform of choice that the best corporate legal teams run on. - Run the full corporate calendar and on Legora. Start with the rhythm every company keeps: entity formation, Board and committee meetings, approvals and equity grants. Then mature it into the rhythm a public company requires: quaterly earnings cycle preparation, disclosures, public filings and trading windows.
